purpose: Nationwide and research-grade observed EV charging-session acquisition. Candidate status never implies licensing, access, or site-level session availability.

national_candidates.name: Joint Office EV-ChART
national_candidates.notes: Quarterly charging-session data are collected for federally funded infrastructure. Raw portal access is limited to funding recipients/authorized parties; public outputs are aggregated/anonymized. Hunt state recipient publications and public reports, not restricted raw records.

national_candidates.name: DOE Livewire / EV WATTS
national_candidates.notes: Nationwide real-world EVSE dataset and analytics include sessions, utilization and energy. Verify current downloadable geographic resolution and reuse terms before ingest.

national_candidates.name: California Energy Commission funded-project reporting
national_candidates.notes: CEC-funded projects submit detailed utilization/session data. Individual-charger utilization may be confidential, but public grant/project reports can contain publishable site/project aggregates.

national_candidates.name: Stable Auto
national_candidates.notes: Markets nationwide utilization intelligence based on real charging operating data. Requires commercial evaluation and explicit purchasing authority before any paid integration.

national_candidates.name: AFDC charging-network directory
national_candidates.notes: Strong national inventory/network directory for identifying operators and station IDs. Inventory is not session telemetry and must never be promoted to observed usage.

privacy_rule: Aggregate at ingest; do not persist driver IDs, user IDs, ID tags, payment identifiers, or other direct session-user identifiers in RIVET harvest artifacts.

sources.name: NYC PlugNYC municipal charging sessions
sources.freshness_note: NYC Open Data reported an update on 2026-09-08.
sources.session_fields_note: Public transaction date, station/location IDs, connected/disconnected times, durations, energy and status; invalidity-marked rows are excluded before aggregation.

sources.name: Town of Cary EV charging sessions
sources.session_fields_note: Public Town-owned charging-session dataset; full-result export endpoint is used.

sources.name: City of Boulder EV charging station energy consumption
sources.session_fields_note: Public session records; resolver follows current or historical ArcGIS wrappers to the public FeatureServer.

sources.name: City of Palo Alto EV charging station usage
sources.session_fields_note: Public CSV covers July 2011-Dec 2020. Portal API requires a key, so no automated bypass is attempted.

sources.name: DOE Livewire EV WATTS Public Database
sources.session_fields_note: National real-world EV/EVSE dataset; verify file-level geography and session schema before site-resolved promotion.

sources.name: ACN-Data Caltech/JPL/Office charging sessions
sources.session_fields_note: Session-level observed data; API registration token required, no bypass permitted.

sources.name: PennDOT NEVI charging station usage
sources.session_fields_note: Observed quarterly/cumulative sessions and kWh are public, but statewide aggregates do not satisfy site-resolved coverage.

sources.name: City of Ottawa public EV charging station usage
sources.session_fields_note: Official public City feed with session/transaction IDs, dates, site/address/station and kWh; direct identifiers are never persisted.

sources.name: City of Evanston city-owned EV charging station usage
sources.session_fields_note: Historical city-owned charging usage Jan 2016-Aug 2017; revalidate current Socrata endpoint before automatic harvesting.

sources.name: Dundee City Council public EV charge point usage series
sources.session_fields_note: DCC publishes completed public-chargepoint sessions for 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 periods. Preserve per-dataset licensing before automated reuse.

sources.name: Perth & Kinross Council EV charge station usage series
sources.session_fields_note: Anonymous individual charging sessions published by Perth & Kinross Council under ChargePlace Scotland.

sources.name: Georgia Tech high-resolution workplace EV charging sessions
sources.session_fields_note: 3,395 anonymized workplace sessions across 105 stations and 25 sites; useful for behavioral priors, not automatically local observed evidence.

sources.name: Simon Fraser University EV Parking Dataset
sources.session_fields_note: EV charging sessions since 2019; keep separate from site-local observations outside SFU.

sources.name: Norway residential EV charging dataset 35k sessions
sources.session_fields_note: More than 35,000 residential sessions across 12 locations, including plug-in/out and energy; behavioral prior lane.

queries: electric vehicle charging station usage sessions
catalog_hunters.purpose: Discover official public datasets. Candidate discovery is not session acceptance.
